40.title: Multiple-choice cloze — escolha a forma correta

items.q: If the pandemic ___ , we wouldn't have gone hybrid. (a) didn't happen (b) hadn't happened (c) wouldn't happen
If we had kept the old policy, we ___ talent. (a) would lose (b) would have lost (c) lost
They ___ stayed if we had offered flexibility. (a) would have (b) would (c) had

40.title: Error correction (editing) — ache e corrija o erro
40.note: Um erro por frase. Corrija e diga por quê.

items.q: If the pandemic didn't happen, we wouldn't have gone hybrid.
items.a: If the pandemic hadn't happened, we wouldn't have gone hybrid. (3º condicional → if + past perfect)

items.q: If we had kept the policy, we would lost talent.
items.a: If we had kept the policy, we would have lost talent. (resultado → would have + particípio)

items.q: They would have stay if we had been flexible.
items.a: They would have stayed if we had been flexible. (would have + particípio: stayed)

items.q: If managers would have set boundaries, people would have felt calmer.
items.a: If managers had set boundaries, people would have felt calmer. (oração 'if' → past perfect, não would have)

items.q: We would have saved money if we go remote earlier.
items.a: We would have saved money if we had gone remote earlier. (oração 'if' → had + particípio)

items.q: If we had used async tools, time zones wouldn't be a problem.
items.a: If we had used async tools, time zones wouldn't have been a problem. (resultado no passado → wouldn't have been)

40.title: Fale sobre você / Discuss — Third Conditional no seu trabalho
40.note: Respostas-modelo de nível B1–B2 que o aluno adapta.

items.q: How would things have been different without the pandemic?
items.a: If the pandemic hadn't happened, we wouldn't have adopted hybrid work so quickly, and many teams would still be fully office-based.

items.q: What would have happened if your company had kept the old policy?
items.a: If we had kept the old policy, we would have lost a lot of talent, because people now expect flexibility.

items.q: How could earlier action have helped your company?
items.a: If we had introduced hybrid work sooner, we would have retained more people and we would have saved on office costs.

items.q: What would have improved well-being in the past?
items.a: If managers had set clearer boundaries, people wouldn't have felt always on, and there would have been less burnout.

items.q: How would better tools have changed remote work?
items.a: If we had used more asynchronous tools, time zones wouldn't have been a problem and collaboration would have been smoother.

items.q: What mistake do you wish your company had avoided?
items.a: If we had planned the policy properly from the start, it would have worked better and people wouldn't have been confused.
